purpose: Express that something has a strongly felt quality.
keywords: V dictionary / い-adjective / な-adjectiveな + ものがある
There is something moving about her words.
There is something mysterious about this silence.
Taking it all on alone is quite demanding.
formation: V dictionary / い-adjective / な-adjectiveな + ものがある
restrictions: Often used for personal impressions such as moving, difficult, or convincing.
mistake: It means a felt quality, not possession of a physical object.
